During the pilot run on Molding Line 4, the Quality Department conducted several checks and reached the following conclusions:
 
  The temperature remains within established parameters.
 
  The tank collection test yielded the following weights: Tank 1: 694.3 g; Tank 2: 1,270.7 g; and Tank 3: 4,436.3 g.
 
  Final product weights ranged from 11.91 g to 12.04 g. The first check showed an average of 11.95 g, while the second and final check showed an average of 12.00 g. Part dimensions varied from 1.8 m to 2.1 m at the top and from 2.4 m to 2.7 m at the bottom.
 
  Finally—and importantly—organoleptic characteristics were evaluated. It is evident that some parts still exhibit incomplete coating on the back, while others emerge without the mint filling. In-line inspections and checks are ongoing to identify and correct these issues and optimize the product.
